subject: Exec OKR heatmap + prioritization & fiscal scenarios
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Exec OKR heatmap + prioritization & fiscal scenarios

Team —

Kickoff note for annual planning: attached is the first-pass OKR heatmap (OKR-heatmap-v1.xlsx) and a short set of FY28 scenarios (fy28-scenarios.pdf). Goal: surface three prioritization buckets and identify which initiatives we want carved out for Dedicated/Private go-to-market investments vs. product bets that should be deferred.

Asks: 
- Please review the heatmap and mark any objectives you think should move between High / Medium / Low priority by EOD Wed (4/21).
- Marissa: can you confirm the baseline FY28 spend envelope and include a downside (-15%) scenario in the doc?
- Jonas: recommend two cross-functional owners for the top 6 initiatives so we can start resource conversations.

I'll run a 30-min prioritization sync Thurs (4/22) — propose 9:00 AM PT. If that won't work for your calendar, flag alternate times. We'll use the QBR-agenda-draft.md as the structure for vice presidents and the board readout.

Attachments: [attachment: OKR-heatmap-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 47KB)], [attachment: fy28-scenarios.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)]

Thanks,
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Head of Strategy & Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec OKR heatmap + prioritization & fiscal scenarios

Thanks, Jasmine — skimmed the heatmap. A few quick notes inline: 

- Growth/Managed Accounts objective looks underweighted relative to pipeline velocity in Q3; recommend bump to High.
- Inferencing runtime cost optimization should be Medium -> High if we plan to push Dedicated capacity this year (saves $/token).
- Remove duplicate row for "Model onboarding automation" — merged in our product backlog as M-3.

I'll put tentative owners for the top six and share an updated sheet by Tue EOD. Agree on 9:00 AM PT Thurs unless there are blocking exec conflicts.

On Marissa's ask: if we assume a 10% revenue uplift from the Dedicated push and conservative retention, I can model the throughput requirements that justify 1.5–2.0 p95 TTFB SLO improvements. Will need a small cross-org meeting with Serving Runtime to get kernel-level estimates.

Regards,
Vivek
CEO (interim)
Redwood Inference

Thanks — attaching a short fiscal memo that lays out three envelopes: Base, Downside (-15%), and Stretch (+12%). I've added a cash runway slide and a table that maps spend to hiring bands for Eng/CS/Go-to-market. See attached: fy28-scenarios.pdf.

Quick notes: 
- Base assumes incremental revenue from Hosted API growth but *not* the Dedicated expansion until Q3.
- Downside is a conservative beta adoption case; we should surface which initiatives are no-regret under Downside so we can preserve optionality.
- Stretch shows invest-in growth scenario where we accelerate Dedicated and Private sales motions; that's the only path that supports a +12% headcount plan.

Action: Jasmine — I'll add the mapping to the OKR heatmap and flag initiatives that are funded in each envelope. Target to update both artifacts by Tue 4/21 EOD.

Attachment: [attachment: fy28-scenarios.pdf (application/pdf, 124KB)]

-Marissa

Hi Jasmine / Marissa —

Thanks for sharing. A couple of questions from our side as the potential channel partner: 

1) If the Dedicated push moves forward under the Stretch scenario, will you be able to commit to co-marketing funds in Q4? We typically ask for a minimum $75k co-marketing tranche for joint pilots.
2) What are your expected production latency SLAs for partner pilots? We need >99.5% availability and <300ms median latency for our initial integration tests.

We're flexible on timing but would need those two items clarified before drafting a pilot statement of work. Happy to join the Thurs prioritization sync if it's useful.

Best,
Priya
Head of Partnerships
Acme Analytics
